Maintenance procedures aiming to guarantee the perfect efficiency of the 
 components involved in the condensing system should be strictly observed as a 
 matter of fact a decrease in efficiency of failure of any of these units will 
 adversely effect the condenser performance.

items: Carefully check for all condenser valves.
Stuffing box of suction pumps
Valves in vacuum service.
Gasket for flange point.
Tubes of condenser.

This inspection determine the extent of corrosion and decrease periodic 
 inspection to condenser and tubes.

sections.text:
In case of re-change of some tubes due to its defection these 
 tools must be available:

items:
Milling cutter for tubes facing and beveling and for removal of welding 
 material.
Tube wall reducing tools.
Tube collapsing tool
Tube knockout tool

Remove the inlet and return water boxes or if is feasible open the hinged / 
 bolted covers.
Remove the seal welding if present with tool (1).

Remove the expanded ends of the tube to a depth of approximately three 
 fourth's the sheet thickness using tool (2)

Collapse the tube ends with tool (3) to relax the tube to tube sheet joint 
 exercise care to prevent damage to the tube seat in the tube plate.

Insert the tool (4) and drift the tube free of the tube sheet in the direction 
 of the inlet or flared end.
Tube guide tool.

Milling culler for tubes facing and beveling and for removal of welding 
 material.
Tube expanding tool.
Tube welding machine.

Tube end and tube sheets shall be carefully cleaned and any presser votive 
 removed with suitable solvent any corrosion is to be removed with fine emery 
 cloth. It is fundamental that the contact surfaces be free of all foreign 
 material.

Use tool (1) to guide the tube through the tube sheet and the tube support. 
 Maintain a contact axial force on tube as it moves into the condenser. If the 
 tube meets positive resistance at the support plates rotate the tube while 
 maintaining the axial force be careful not to score the tube set the ends to 
 project from the tube sheet as per welding and expanding tube tube sheet 
 procedure shall be used.

The tube is now ready to be joined with tube sheet. The welding and expanding 
 tube tube sheet procedure shall be used.
Install all bolts for entering and exiting the condenser.
Close the drain of condenser, then the condenser become ready to operation.

Tube Installing
Tube end and tube sheets shall be carefully cleaned and any presser votive

The tube is now ready to be joined with tube sheet. The welding and expanding

Install all bolts for entering and exiting the condenser.
